notes: 'Small' read as the village, not the map: a 4x4 map with one fishing hamlet.
Hamlet: sunshine_cove (two Sunshine Coast beach houses, three boats, barrels, a whale bone).
Coast: the sea fills the south (30% of the map); the land rises from it to cliffs on the other three sides.
The player starts at the hamlet.
Phase 7b: no size given, so the default for one village and no lakes or mountains applies: 3x3 (480 m). Low cliffs with a boulder rim around the play area; the sea fills the open south edge.
name: Mapgen Coast
